nodes.text: Owen, seeing Paige and Lee, grabs Maria's hand and pulls her onto the dance floor!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Come on!
Suddenly both couples are dancing side by side, holding each other tightly!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Wow, Owen! You're `way` into dancing!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow, Owen! You're [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] into dancing!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Tonight's a special occasion!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Is it Dancing With Dogs Day already?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What'd you say?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Don't pay attention to her!
You are now playing as $ALLISON.
A slower, relaxed song begins to play...
From their table, $ALLISON points out the dueling couples on the dance floor.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: What's going on over there?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It's a bizarre jealousy thing. I can't even begin to comprehend it.
At that moment, Spencer arrives...
...With Kimi!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Actually, I think I `am` ready for that dance now!
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, I think I [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] ready for that dance now!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Okay...
...She has failed.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No... But, uh... Wow, you look so hot!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What are you doing way over there? I'm not going to bite!
Paige pulls Lee closer in...

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: I see what you're trying to do...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And?

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: And I'm actually pretty cool with it.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Guys are kind of easy that way.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Heh.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, look... I'm trying to make Owen jealous!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: You're... Using me?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: A little bit.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, maybe a lot, but I `am` telling the truth.
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, maybe a lot, but I [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] telling the truth.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Wow. Congratulations.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: You know, telling the truth doesn't entitle you to a free 'Act horribly' card.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Also, I was kind of hoping we might rekindle something tonight...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's probably not going to happen...

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Yeah, thanks, I figured that out five seconds ago.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Still, we could try to have fun together, right?

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Whatever. Stop trying to play me and just do what you have to do.
Paige somewhat reluctantly pulls Lee closer in.
As Cameron leads $ALLISON out onto the dance floor, she feels her body going numb...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Ooo...
Cameron holds her tight against him! Her heart pounds, her vision blurs, and everything spins.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You okay?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Ooo...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: $ALLISON? $ALLISON?
Cameron steps back, and $ALLISON faints, falling forward into his arms!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Ooo!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Oof!
$ALLISON feels something, she's not sure what...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Huh...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I think that's enough, Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, come on. Let me slap her one more time.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's not like she's going to stop you.
$ALLISON sits up.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: See? It worked!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh, you regained consciousness naturally.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I meant before that.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You face-planted into Mr. Hunk-o's biceps.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You passed out, and Cameron caught you.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh no... Where is he?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Gone...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: No, this was supposed to be my first kiss!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That ship sailed, sister.
And $ALLISON realizes, through a fog of semi-consciousness that...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Actually, I think I'd prefer it if we intermingled with others beforehand...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Intermingled? Did you really just say that? Am I supposed to just let that ridiculous word slide by?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'd prefer that, yes...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I have a few people I want to check up on first.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Fine by me. Let's go intermingle.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's Delilah. She doesn't go to this school, so we've been texting each other.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That's quite sweet of you.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sweet? It's a nightmare!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I've never texted before! She wrote 'rofl' to me, and I thought it meant 'really odd, funky loser'.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Every time I said something funny, I thought she was cutting me to my core...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I see how that could cause some confusion...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Even worse, I want to ask her to the dance, but I can't summon the nerve! I'm afraid the brave Erik you've come to know disappears when it comes to texting...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Right...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, it seems like you're really taken by this girl...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I am. This could be my first `real` relationship, and I don't want to blow my chance!
nodes.text_bbcode: I am. This could be my first [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] relationship, and I don't want to blow my chance!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm definitely not the expert on relationships...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: But I think you have to risk making a mistake. You have to risk saying the wrong thing. You have to risk being rejected, being hurt.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That sounds potentially painful...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I think that's what risk is.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Like how sometimes in Ogres 'N' Elves, my giant will open a treasure chest knowing there could be a trap?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yes! Like that!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I think...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, happy hot dogs! I'm going to ask her right now!
Erik giddily types out a message and presses the 'send' button on his phone...
Paige suddenly shouts from the other end of the room!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I just can't believe you're acting like such a baby, Owen!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: A baby? Really?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And you're still planning on taking Lee?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Who else would I take?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, since I'm super cool with you going with Lee, I guess you'll be super cool with whoever `I` take.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, since I'm super cool with you going with Lee, I guess you'll be super cool with whoever [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] take.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah! Obviously!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wait... Who are you going with?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm not sure, but let's face it, I can go with whoever I want!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And whoever I go with, no matter how hot they are, you're cool with that, yeah?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yep! I'm totally cool with that! Why wouldn't I be?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Is it just me, Erik? Or is this an unusually dramatic dance event we're about to attend?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No, this is pretty crazy...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's like a peanut butter and jelly sandwich with `two` different kinds of jelly!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's like a peanut butter and jelly sandwich with [color=#e23b3b][i]two[/i][/color] different kinds of jelly!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I can't wait...
It's the night of the Homecoming Dance!
As $ALLISON and Cameron enter, $ALLISON marvels at the lights, the decorations, and the crowd of dressed-up students!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It's so beautiful...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I was thinking the same thing about you.
She blushes.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Should we get straight to dancing?
$ALLISON can feel her knees shaking!
$ALLISON heads over to the restroom door and knocks lightly on it...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Kimi, it's me, $ALLISON, I'd really like to--

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: GO AWAY!
Unable to help, $ALLISON sits down at Erik's table...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What about you, Erik? Can I help you?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I guess I `am` usually an afterthought...
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess I [color=#e23b3b][i]am[/i][/color] usually an afterthought...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I didn't mean it like that...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's okay, I guess I could use some help.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What's the problem?
$ALLISON approaches Erik...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Hey, Erik, I heard you moaning just now. Has something upset you?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It has, actually! Thanks for coming to me right away... I'm usually an afterthought!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I don't think of you that way...
Unable to help, $ALLISON sits down at Erik's table...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What about you, Erik? Can I help you?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I guess I `am` usually an afterthought...
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess I [color=#e23b3b][i]am[/i][/color] usually an afterthought...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I didn't mean it like that...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's okay, I guess I could use some help.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What's the problem?
$ALLISON sits down near Paige's side of the couch...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Psst! Paige, is there anything I can do for you?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You've done enough already! Now I'm committed to taking Lee to the dance!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Why don't you just tell Owen the truth?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Because as soon as he knows I'm waiting for him, it'll seem like I want to get back together!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: But aren't you together?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yes! But not officially `together` together! We're not together for real!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes! But not officially [color=#3b78e2][i]together[/i][/color] together! We're not together for real!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It's possible this relationship is too complicated for me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, so maybe butt out then!
Unable to help, $ALLISON sits down at Erik's table...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What about you, Erik? Can I help you?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I guess I `am` usually an afterthought...
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess I [color=#e23b3b][i]am[/i][/color] usually an afterthought...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I didn't mean it like that...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's okay, I guess I could use some help.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What's the problem?
$ALLISON sits down near Owen's side of the couch...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Psst! Owen, is there anything I can do for you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't think so! Unless you know how to keep `her` away from me.
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't think so! Unless you know how to keep [color=#e23b3b][i]her[/i][/color] away from me.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I... I know about you and Paige... Your secret.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You... You do?
$ALLISON nods.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Why don't you just admit that you want to get back together?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No offense, but you don't know how Paige works. Admitting that would destroy everything.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It's possible that this relationship is too complicated for me.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks for trying to help.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Sure...
Unable to help, $ALLISON sits down at Erik's table...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What about you, Erik? Can I help you?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I guess I `am` usually an afterthought...
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess I [color=#e23b3b][i]am[/i][/color] usually an afterthought...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I didn't mean it like that...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's okay, I guess I could use some help.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What's the problem?
$ALLISON walks over to Spencer...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I... I just wanted to see if I could help with--

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't need help! I just need to get through this exercise. By myself.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Is this because I'm attending the dance with--

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Why are you still talking to me?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Fine. Sorry for wanting to help!
Unable to help, $ALLISON sits down at Erik's table...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What about you, Erik? Can I help you?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I guess I `am` usually an afterthought...
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess I [color=#e23b3b][i]am[/i][/color] usually an afterthought...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I didn't mean it like that...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's okay, I guess I could use some help.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What's the problem?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Hey, Kimi...
Kimi peeks at Kevin's hands, noticing that they're empty...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: The fireworks must be outside! With the balloons! And the horse!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Uh, not sure what that's about, but the other nerds just reminded me there's a dance or something coming up...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: ...We're going together, right?
Kimi's mouth drops.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Uh oh...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Here comes the show in three, two, one...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No desirability, no confidence, nothing elaborate! That was `officially` the worst ask-out in the history of recorded ask-outs!
nodes.text_bbcode: No desirability, no confidence, nothing elaborate! That was [color=#3b78e2][i]officially[/i][/color] the worst ask-out in the history of recorded ask-outs!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You scored, like, a zero!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Uh... What are you talking about?
Kimi looks back at Paige and $ALLISON, her face turning red...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm talking about the Homecoming Dance...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...Which I stressed was super important to me!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...You're supposed to do something big and romantic, something that proves just how much you actually care about me...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I care about you...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I don't... I don't know that you do.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: This whole time I thought you were distant with me because you were preparing this big romantic gesture...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But now I'm finding out that you were `just distant` with me...
nodes.text_bbcode: But now I'm finding out that you were [color=#3b78e2][i]just distant[/i][/color] with me...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Who cares about this stuff anyway? It's lame.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: No, it isn't lame! What's lame is you playing video games `all` the time!
nodes.text_bbcode: No, it isn't lame! What's lame is you playing video games [color=#3b78e2][i]all[/i][/color] the time!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I went to `one` LAN match!
nodes.text_bbcode: I went to [color=#e23b3b][i]one[/i][/color] LAN match!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, one `this week!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, one [color=#3b78e2][i]this week![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And I'm perfectly fine with LAN matches with the guys, but only if that means you give me time too!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I give you time!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Playing video games with me in the room does `not` count, Kevin!
nodes.text_bbcode: Playing video games with me in the room does [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] count, Kevin!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You know what? Forget it! I'm tired of being a third wheel!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: What does that mean?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It means we're through! I just broke up with you! Now you can play games while I go to the dance with someone who actually cares!
Kimi storms off, straight into the Student Lounge, $ALLISON and Paige trailing behind her!
Before they enter, Paige stops $ALLISON...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: When we get in there, find out who Owen's going to the dance with!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What? Why?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm a friend and I need to know, okay?!
Before $ALLISON can reply, Paige marches off into the lounge!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: And I thought things would be `more` mature in high school...
nodes.text_bbcode: And I thought things would be [color=#3b78e2][i]more[/i][/color] mature in high school...

nodes.text: In the Student Lounge, Owen, Spencer, and Erik all have stunned looks on their faces.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Where'd Kimi go?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: She called all of us 'idiot pig dummies' and then slammed the bathroom door shut.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Did something happen?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: She just broke up with Kevin.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh no...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Should one of us talk to her?

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: The next person who says anything to me's going to get a taste of bathroom tile!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Maybe not right now...
A few moments later...
Kimi is still in the bathroom, Spencer is doing physical therapy exercises back and forth across the room.
Erik is staring at his phone, and Paige and Owen are studying on opposite ends of the couch...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: So, Owen, with whom are you attending the dance?
Owen immediately glances at Paige...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... I know I'm going with... Someone.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You are? Who?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, I haven't actually asked anyone yet. Why? Who are you going with?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh, Paige hasn't actually--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Lee! I'm going with Lee!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Really? Popped collar guy?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What do you care who I take?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't!
Owen pulls a book from his backpack and flips it open, turning his back on Paige!
Meanwhile, Erik is making strange whimpering noises while staring at his phone...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oooooog...
And Spencer is getting increasingly frustrated by his injured leg!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Grr! Stupid! Leg!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Seems like everyone's got a problem right now... Who can I actually help?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! Yes!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Calm down, Kiss Whisperer.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Tip one! Close your eyes! No one wants to kiss a bug-eyed alien!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Closed eyes are also a way of signaling to him to make a move.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That makes sense...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ooh! Tip two! Head tilt! Don't forget!
Kimi tilts her head slightly to demonstrate.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Why is that necessary when--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Tip three! Once your lips touch, open your mouth `a little,` like you just heard something surprising but not shocking.
nodes.text_bbcode: Tip three! Once your lips touch, open your mouth [color=#3b78e2][i]a little,[/i][/color] like you just heard something surprising but not shocking.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This is too much.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Like this?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, that's good!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh, there's one more tip.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, one obvious tip.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What's that?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Relax. Seriously.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That's a hard one because you're going to feel, like, a thousand pounds of nervous, but it'll make the whole experience `way` better!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's a hard one because you're going to feel, like, a thousand pounds of nervous, but it'll make the whole experience [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] better!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You'll be like, 'Ohmygosh! This is great!', and he'll be like, 'Yeah. Awesome. $ALLISON's the best kisser!' Trust us.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I will. Thank you for helping me.
Just then, Kevin turns the corner...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Eeeeep! This is it!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I do! I do!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Do `not` wear braces and kiss a guy who is also wearing braces!
nodes.text_bbcode: Do [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] wear braces and kiss a guy who is also wearing braces!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Because yes, your faces will get stuck together.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: 'Cause that applies here.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: She could get braces later on in life...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: More relevant. Don't kiss directly after an Italian meal. So much garlic breath.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ew.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, I kissed a guy once who darted his tongue in and out like a lizard. Don't do that.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Super ew.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Then again, `I` kissed a guy who didn't actually move his mouth. It was like making out with a statue.
nodes.text_bbcode: Then again, [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] kissed a guy who didn't actually move his mouth. It was like making out with a statue.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hahaha! Well I made out with a guy who...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: These are funny stories, but I am not learning anything...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I am sorry to interrupt but--
Just then, Kevin turns the corner...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Eeeeep! This is it!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Looks like I missed my chance...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I guess that means Paige and Owen really `are` secretly dating!
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess that means Paige and Owen really [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] secretly dating!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Anyway, enough of that! Let's get back to... Cam$ALLISONon? $ALLISONeron? Camer$ALLISON?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't say any of those names ever again.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Whatever. Check this out!
Kimi pulls out a sheet of paper from her folder...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I was `so` bored in Mr. Dean's class, so I started ranking all the different ask-outs!
nodes.text_bbcode: I was [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] bored in Mr. Dean's class, so I started ranking all the different ask-outs!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Totally normal.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: In the end, I gave Cameron's ask-out a 45 out of 50.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It scored high in most categories... Desirability, confidence, surprise... But fell short of perfect because it wasn't very elaborate since he just asked you directly.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Honestly, it just felt nice to be asked.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Of course! And a 45 is a great score! I'm just so excited for whatever Kevin's planned!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: He's been so distant lately...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I `know` that means he's been working on something `big!` Maybe skywriting?! Or hundreds of balloons?! Or something involving a horse?!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] that means he's been working on something [color=#3b78e2][i]big![/i][/color] Maybe skywriting?! Or hundreds of balloons?! Or something involving a horse?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Eeeep! Whatever it is, I just know that it'll be `so` special! A 50 for sure!
nodes.text_bbcode: Eeeep! Whatever it is, I just know that it'll be [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] special! A 50 for sure!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatevs...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What about you, $ALLISON, are you ready for the dance?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I believe so.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Cameron will be meeting me there. Is that standard?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Standard for most guys? No. Standard Cameron? Yes.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Additionally, I've acquired shoes, a suitable dress, and what I believe are all the prerequisite accessories for a dance.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Did you also find a vacuum? Because you're really sucking the fun out of this...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Sorry, this is all new to me. I've never attended a dance.
Kimi and Paige immediately stop walking.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Never...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...Been...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...To a dance?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Never. I mean, I was more focused on studies in middle school...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...Says no one ever!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! Wait... Have you ever been `kissed?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ohmygosh! Wait... Have you ever been [color=#3b78e2][i]kissed?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I haven't... Is that a part of going to a dance? Because that would explain my day.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, now that everyone knows I'm going to the dance with Cameron, today's been... A little weird...
Before school...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You don't even know how lucky you are! Kissing Cameron is like having a motorcycle in your mouth.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Is that... Desirable?
In Mr. Dean's class...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I heard you're going with Cameron. Do `not` tell him I said this as it goes against everything I'm about...
nodes.text_bbcode: I heard you're going with Cameron. Do [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] tell him I said this as it goes against everything I'm about...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: But there are three stages in your life... Before Cameron kisses you...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: While Cameron's kissing you...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: And after Cameron kisses you...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Are you in the before stage or the after stage?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: All I know is I'm not in the best stage...
At lunch...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Oh yeah, we made out for an hour once. That was the same day that I lost my credit card and fell into some mud in my favorite skirt...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Best day of my life.
The present...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: A `very` weird day, actually...
nodes.text_bbcode: A [color=#3b78e2][i]very[/i][/color] weird day, actually...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, those girls know what they're talking about...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Don't tell me there's also a rankings list of which boys are the best kissers...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh... There `might` be.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... There [color=#3b78e2][i]might[/i][/color] be.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Really? You have a serious problem, Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Maybe I do, but `Kimi's Pecking Order` is coming in handy right now, isn't it?
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe I do, but [color=#3b78e2][i]Kimi's Pecking Order[/i][/color] is coming in handy right now, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And since I know both of you are dying to know, Cameron is far and away the `best` kisser at Twin Branches!
nodes.text_bbcode: And since I know both of you are dying to know, Cameron is far and away the [color=#3b78e2][i]best[/i][/color] kisser at Twin Branches!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: If Cameron's the best kisser, then I suppose I should feel lucky...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You don't?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Honestly, I'm just nervous.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Duh. That's because you don't know anything about kissing!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: The first time I kissed a guy, I slammed my face into his so hard, I actually bruised my mouth!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Hahaha!

options.label: Do you have any more stories?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Like they're, um, keeping a secret?
Kimi whirls toward Paige!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! A secret! What secret?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: There's no secret! We broke up! We hate each other! That's it!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Then why were you smiling that day like $ALLISON said?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't remember, but I was probably happy after winning that fight with Owen!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Now can we please move on? I'm not made of glass, but the more I think about him and me actually dating, the more nauseous I get...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sure...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But, do you remember when he first kissed you over that ice cream?!... Ooh! Or when he rode in on that horse on the beach?! Or my favorite Powen moment was when he...
...As Kimi prattles on, Paige whispers to $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Real smooth.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I apologize. I've never been very good at distorting the truth.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, then shut up about it from now on.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Like they're... Oh, hey, we didn't talk about what dress you're planning on wearing, Kimi?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Well, I `was` thinking about designing my own, of course!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] thinking about designing my own, of course!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Of course...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But then I saw this one dress in the mall that was to die for! I mean `to. Die. For.`
nodes.text_bbcode: But then I saw this one dress in the mall that was to die for! I mean [color=#3b78e2][i]to. Die. For.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Picture this. Bright cutout purple top with a black high-low skirt! Plus...
As Kimi describes her dress, Paige whispers to $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Thanks for that.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: No problem. Your secret's safe.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Keep it that way...
$ALLISON relaxes, her body melting against Cameron's...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Sooooo warm...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It wasn't the best kiss... But I think that's `my` fault.
nodes.text_bbcode: It wasn't the best kiss... But I think that's [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] fault.

nodes.text: Cameron pulls back, frowning.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Is something wrong?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Uh, no, that was a good kiss. Really... Good.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm forming the impression that it actually wasn't.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I guess that's to be expected, for my first.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I can't believe it! I can't believe it! My first kiss!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Is my posture okay?! Am I kissing too hard?! Too soft?! How about saliva control?! Oh no! I'm freaking out!
$ALLISON's panic makes her go stiff!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You okay?
She nods, and he resumes kissing her.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Now, I just need to remember to...
$ALLISON opens her mouth wide...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Mmff!
Cameron pulls back!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Is something wrong?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: No, just felt like I was getting sucked into your face for a second there...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Take two?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Sure...
He comes back toward her...
She opens her mouth just a little bit...
Cameron holds her face with both hands, kissing her passionately!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It's happening!
Their lips touch, and $ALLISON opens her mouth, like she's...
She tilts her head...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: This. Is. Happening!
She keeps her head straight...
...And their noses smash into each other!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Ow!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Ow!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: It's okay, you just forgot to tilt your head...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yes... `Forgot.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes... [color=#3b78e2][i]Forgot.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ALLISON tilts her head, and Cameron pulls her in.
She can feel Cameron pulling her towards him.
Then, she...
$ALLISON closes her eyes, her heart pounding!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: This is happening!
$ALLISON stares at Cameron, wide-eyed.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Uh, I'm going to kiss you now.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I kind of figured...
Cameron closes his eyes, moving toward her...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh, whoops. I probably should have done that first...
$ALLISON closes her eyes.
Out on the dance floor, Cameron puts his arms around $ALLISON, and she nervously puts her hands on his shoulders.
They sway to the music...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: So, this is dancing with a guy. It's... Nice.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Penny for the thoughts behind that smile?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I think this thought costs more than a penny.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Why don't you tell me about it outside?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Outside?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Yeah, come on, let's get some air.
Cameron grabs her hand and starts leading her away...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: This is it... This is how he's going to kiss me!
Outside, Cameron leads her to a railing, and they lean against it.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It's pleasant out here...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: One perk of California winter.
$ALLISON looks up at the stars in the night sky...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: When my sister Amanda and I were really little, we used to make up our own constellations.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: That must have been cute.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'd always find them, and she'd name them. I remember she called one of them 'Gus', and we thought that was the funniest thing. Especially--
$ALLISON looks back at Cameron, noticing just how close he is to her, their arms touching, his face and eyes filling her vision.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: What? Why'd you stop?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Nothing. I... I got distracted.
Cameron reaches out and sweeps a lock of hair away from $ALLISON's eyes...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You're not like your sister...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I wouldn't think so.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You're not like any girl I've ever met...
$ALLISON can feel herself blushing.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I've always liked you... Even when I first met you...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You're `so` smart, and `so` beautiful.
nodes.text_bbcode: You're [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] smart, and [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] beautiful.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Cameron, I don't--
Cameron cups her face in his warm hand, and $ALLISON looks up at him...
Cameron steps back...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Wait... That was your first kiss? Are you serious?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yes... Is that a problem?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Actually, it kind of is.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I don't know how to explain this...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I've kissed `a lot` of girls, $ALLISON.
nodes.text_bbcode: I've kissed [color=#e23b3b][i]a lot[/i][/color] of girls, $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I think I met some of them the other day...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You're so smart and well-spoken, I think it's easy to forget just how young you are...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm not `that` young.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] young.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Says the girl who just had her first kiss...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It's not like you're that much older than me.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I know, I know... But I know the experiences I've had, I know what I'm about...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: And I think I know what you deserve.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That's really unfair.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You deserve someone better than me...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Cameron...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You deserve someone who can experience high school `with` you, not someone who's already been through it...
nodes.text_bbcode: You deserve someone who can experience high school [color=#e23b3b][i]with[/i][/color] you, not someone who's already been through it...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Don't do this!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: This... This was a mistake...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It wasn't...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I'm sorry, $ALLISON. I've... I've gotta go...
Cameron turns away from $ALLISON and heads back into the gym.
Unprepared for the heavy pain in her heart, $ALLISON collapses against the railing, her body shaking uncontrollably. The lights overhead blur as her eyes fill with tears.
A moment later, the door opens...
...And Erik steps out.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: $ALLISON? Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: No... I'm not at all okay!
Erik comes over and leans on the railing next to $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Was it Cameron?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yes! He... I don't know. We weren't together, but... He dumped me!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I... I... Can't believe how much this hurts!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What's the point of opening your heart to anyone if this is what you feel in the end?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I know it feels awful... I've been there before.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You... You have?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sure... I've had tons of crushes on girls who wanted nothing to do with me!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Even worse than that are the ones who wanted something to do with me... Until we spent more time together.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Does it ever get better?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I think love gets better because you get better. Forgive me for discussing it in videogame terms, but...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: The first time you get your heart broken... Well, that's kind of like when you get defeated on a boss level.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Then you press, 'Continue' and you try it again, and you make all this progress, and you get defeated again.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That seems like such a waste, Erik...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It can feel that way... But along the way, you learn, and you get stronger, and at some point you do it. You find real love.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: How has `this` made me stronger? I just got my heart broken...
nodes.text_bbcode: How has [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] made me stronger? I just got my heart broken...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah, it was your first heartbreak, but I'm betting it was also your first dance, and your first kiss!
$ALLISON nods...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And not just any first kiss... A Cameron kiss!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Hee! Stop trying to make me laugh!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: This, this right here is a first for me, too, you know?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What is?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's my first, very personal, consoling, helping-$ALLISON-in-need moment!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That's a specific moment.
$ALLISON sniffles, her eyes clearing up...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: How'd you know I was out here?
Erik fiddles with his glasses.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh, just a hunch!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, I'm glad you came...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Me too...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: So, what'd I miss in there?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Let's see...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Kimi and Spencer came to the dance together...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I saw.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But I think they just came as friends. I don't know how much you care, since you just kissed Cameron.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I hear he's been number one on Kimi's Pecking Order for five months straight!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I wish I knew what it was like to kiss a `number one` like Cameron!
nodes.text_bbcode: I wish I knew what it was like to kiss a [color=#e23b3b][i]number one[/i][/color] like Cameron!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You know, if Cameron were my preferred gender.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: What about Paige and Owen?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh! Ha! They got into a dance-off and then Paige and Lee left to go have some 'rich people fun.'

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Whatever that is...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And then Owen and Maria were right behind them, leaving to go have 'actual fun.' Owen's words.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Hee. And what about you?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, put a twist in my pretzel! Turns out, Delilah's father agreed to let me come over for Thanksgiving Dinner!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That's splendid!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: She invited the whole gang too... Are you in?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'd be delighted.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So it'll be you guys and me and Delilah...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: On a date... With her dad... I've never been more happy and afraid at the same time!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Don't worry, we'll be there to help you out!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I hope so!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Anyway, thank you so much, Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: For what?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: For tonight. For our first very personal consoling `friend` moment.
nodes.text_bbcode: For tonight. For our first very personal consoling [color=#3b78e2][i]friend[/i][/color] moment.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hopefully, the first of many!

Cameron holds out his arm, and $ALLISON takes it.
The two of them head over toward a table at the edge of the dance floor, where Erik is sitting and smiling.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Howdy! You two look like a magazine cover!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Is that good?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Why are you so happy, Erik? Was Delilah able to come?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: The opposite, actually!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Apparently, if she'd come to the dance with me, it would've officially been our first date!

nodes.speaker: Erik

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: So...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So, she's not here, I'll never get permission from him, and our relationship's completely doomed!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You're taking it pretty well, dude.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Agreed. Why are you so cheerful?
Erik holds up his phone.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I just discovered emoticons! I sent Delilah one that does a funny animation of a heart breaking in two!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: The heart is mine, b.t.w....

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Aww, Erik, I'm `so` sorry...
nodes.text_bbcode: Aww, Erik, I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] sorry...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's okay... I'm used to this kind of thing... Nerds like me aren't really father-impressers...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, I hope you can still find merriment tonight.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Me too. There's always texting, right?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I suppose so...
Erik returns his attention to his phone, and $ALLISON and Cameron move on...
You are now playing as Paige...
Paige marches into the dance, pulling Lee along by the hand!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: This is a pretty cool setup. I'm kind of excited to be here with you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah yeah yeah! Just come with me onto the dance floor!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Uh... Okay.
Paige drags Lee out to the center of the dance floor!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: I guess you `really` want to dance!
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess you [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] want to dance!

nodes.speaker: Paige

A second later, Owen arrives...

nodes.text: Maria!
Lee turns toward the entrance.

nodes.speaker: Lee

It's the night of the Homecoming Dance!
As $ALLISON and Cameron enter, $ALLISON marvels at the lights, the decorations, and the crowd of dressed-up students!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It's so beautiful...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I was thinking the same thing about you.
She blushes.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Should we get straight to dancing?
$ALLISON can feel her knees shaking!
Out on the dance floor, Cameron puts his arms around $ALLISON, and she nervously puts her hands on his shoulders.
They sway to the music...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: So, this is dancing with a guy. It's... Nice.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Penny for the thoughts behind that smile?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I think this thought costs more than a penny.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Why don't you tell me about it outside?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Outside?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Yeah, come on, let's get some air.
Cameron grabs her hand and starts leading her away...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: This is it... This is how he's going to kiss me!
Outside, Cameron leads her to a railing, and they lean against it.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It's pleasant out here...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: One perk of California winter.
$ALLISON looks up at the stars in the night sky...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: When my sister Amanda and I were really little, we used to make up our own constellations.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: That must have been cute.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'd always find them, and she'd name them. I remember she called one of them 'Gus', and we thought that was the funniest thing. Especially--
$ALLISON looks back at Cameron, noticing just how close he is to her, their arms touching, his face and eyes filling her vision.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: What? Why'd you stop?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Nothing. I... I got distracted.
Cameron reaches out and sweeps a lock of hair away from $ALLISON's eyes...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You're not like your sister...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I wouldn't think so.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You're not like any girl I've ever met...
$ALLISON can feel herself blushing.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I've always liked you... Even when I first met you...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You're `so` smart, and `so` beautiful.
nodes.text_bbcode: You're [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] smart, and [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] beautiful.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Cameron, I don't--
Cameron cups her face in his warm hand, and $ALLISON looks up at him...

Spencer and Kimi are sitting at a table near the dance floor.
Want me to get you something to drink?
Ha! Are you kidding me? You can barely walk. I'll go get us drinks.
I know you `could,` but `I'm` going to.
He looks out onto the dance floor and sees $ALLISON and Cameron dancing...
A moment later, Kimi returns with their drinks.
Well, if you didn't want one, you could have just said so!
What?! Oh, I... I didn't notice you were back.
I'm totally kidding with you. Does she know how you feel?
I don't! And I've gotta go do something!
Spencer gets up, hobbling away on his crutches!
But he keeps going, slamming through a side door...
Grrr! Why did I wait to ask her?! How could I be so dumb?!
He angrily throws his crutch across the room! It flies over some boxes and clatters into the corner, the farthest point from him.
Using his one crutch, he positions himself against the wall, scooting in between the stacks of boxes.
Dumbest dance of all time! So stupid--
He stops ranting when he reaches the window, noticing Cameron and $ALLISON outside, alone, together.
Cameron sweeps aside a lock of her hair...
Don't fall for it! Don't fall for it!
Then Cameron leans down, his hands holding her face...
His heart aching, Spencer resumes his quest for his lost crutch. He picks it up, trying not to look out the window... But he can't help sneaking one last glance...
He tries to race out of the room, but the door won't budge! It's locked!
He takes out his phone and sends a text to Erik. 'stuck in the storage room. tell ms lee. help $ALLISON. shes outside. dont tell her it was me.'
A moment later, he watches as Erik comes outside to talk to $ALLISON...
Thanks, buddy... Wish I could have been there.
What does this mean for $ALLISON, Cameron, and Spencer? And how will Erik's Thanksgiving with Delilah go?!

nodes.text: You are now playing as $ALLISON.
In the hallway after school, $ALLISON, Kimi, and Paige are walking toward detention. All around them, students are buzzing about the Homecoming Dance!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I guess Homecoming is kind of a monumental occasion...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Are you kidding?! It's huge! And I cannot believe Cameron asked you to the dance! That was like amazing and just... `Ahhhh!` The best!
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you kidding?! It's huge! And I cannot believe Cameron asked you to the dance! That was like amazing and just... [color=#3b78e2][i]Ahhhh![/i][/color] The best!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So Cameron asked her... What's the big deal?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You're just upset because no guy's asked you yet.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I've been asked plenty. But only by gross guys. The kind with velcro wallets.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: If I might interject... I thought 'gross' was kind of your preferred type. I mean, that's what you're always calling Owen, and--
Kimi pinches $ALLISON!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: `Ow!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ow![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I think it's obvious who Paige won't be going with... A guy we `shouldn't mention by name.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I think it's obvious who Paige won't be going with... A guy we [color=#3b78e2][i]shouldn't mention by name.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh, right...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh. You don't have to treat me like I'm made of glass. Owen and I are...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: ...Mortal enemies?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...Well, it's way, `way` more complicated than that...
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Well, it's way, [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] more complicated than that...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yes, about that... I've been meaning to ask you...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: A while back we were volunteering to deliver food for the Troublemakers program, and you and Owen went into that kitchen together...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: The two of you looked very angry when you came out, but then I saw you smiling...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't remember that!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Ever since then, you've been acting rather odd toward each other.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Odd? We're not acting odd! You're odd!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It seems like the two of you are alone all the time.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It's almost like you're...
$ALLISON notices Paige's eyes go wide!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Like they're what?

pov_note: Multi-POV episode. `pov` on a segment is the playable character in control on entry; a node's `set_pov` switches the current POV mid-stream (these are the game's 'You are now playing as X' cards). A dialogue node's `side` is 'left' when the speaker is the current POV (the game shows the current main on the left) and 'right' otherwise. POV is propagated in execution order from `entry`; only main_characters can hold it.
